name: Tizanidine
summary: Tizanidine is a depressant substance belonging to the Imidazoline, Arylaminoimidazoline chemical class.

combinations.note: Uncertain or unpredictable interaction on PsychonautWiki.

pharmacology.text: Tizanidine is an α2-adrenergic receptor agonist and is closely related to clonidine. It has approximately one-tenth to one-fifteenth of the blood pressure-lowering effect or potency of clonidine. The relation between the α2-adrenergic receptor agonism and spasmolytic action of tizanidine is still not fully understood.
pharmacology.kind: α2-Adrenergic receptor agonist; Muscle relaxant; Sedative; Hypnotic

uses.text: Tizanidine, sold under the brand names Zanaflex and Sirdalud among others, is an α2-adrenergic receptor agonist and muscle relaxant which is used to treat muscle spasticity due to spinal cord injury, multiple sclerosis, and spastic cerebral palsy. The drug is taken orally. It is unclear if use in pregnancy and breastfeeding is safe.

sideEffects.text: Common side effects of tizanidine include sleepiness, dry mouth, asthenia, dizziness, low blood pressure, and low heart rate. Serious side effects may include dangerously low blood pressure, liver problems, and psychosis.
